description:
Perform a buffer analysis on point data and export the result as GeoJSON.

1. Open QGIS (it should already be running).
2. Add the point layer from /home/ga/GIS_Data/sample_points.geojson using Layer > Add Layer > Add Vector Layer.
3. The points are in WGS84 (EPSG:4326). Before buffering, reproject the layer to a projected CRS for accurate distance measurements: right-click the layer > Export > Save Features As, choose format GeoJSON, set CRS to EPSG:3857 (WGS 84 / Pseudo-Mercator), save temporarily.
4. Run the Buffer tool: go to Vector > Geoprocessing Tools > Buffer. Select the reprojected point layer as input. Set the distance to 500 (meters, since EPSG:3857 uses meters). Set segments to 16. Click Run.
5. Export the buffer result: right-click the buffer output layer > Export > Save Features As. Choose GeoJSON format. Save to /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/point_buffers.geojson with CRS EPSG:4326 (WGS84).
6. Verify the output contains 3 polygon features (one buffer per point).
